rate_change_vs_saved_audit: The verified standard rates exactly match the saved audit. Reuse its already-computed per-request write scenario, not a scalar cost rescaling. Figure 6 previously used the no-write scenario.
claude: Unchanged audited Claude tariffs, not newly price-verified in this revision.
limitations: Source model latencies and workloads stay fixed. Mixed-model calls retain their own audited tariff; 5 unpriced mixed calls in GPT-5.5-led groups remain unpriced. These are API-equivalent estimates, not invoices.
